purpose: Compare local end-to-end PPO throughput with complete recovery and hold exposure under an equal transition budget.
initial_timing_budget_reason: 3072 worlds receive only 192 controls each. The 400-control training episode and its final hold are not covered.
before_freeze: Choose and verify the same learner for both arms. Audit side-lying replay around the neck-pitch outlier and hip/knee aggregate drift separately. A new targeted replay change must pass the saved sequence without relaxing either existing drift limit.
Verify matching full episodes, release and hold exposure from actual counters. Quantify distribution and update-clock differences from GAE windows, policy refresh, and KL stops.
Profile zero-step and first real update memory, track host and device memory, temperature, sampling, PPO, copy, clip and wall time. Use the existing 85 percent GPU memory screening limit.
Expose completed updates, actual losses and rewards, checkpoints, and a full original clip through the training observation page.
Keep independent per-pose action criteria. If either arm hits a guard, retain the stopped result and withhold same-budget improvement claims.
